notes.text: Spending and Income are now one page. Use the Spending | Income toggle to switch the charts; there is a single transaction log below.
Fill templates now save automatically, and Generate all from budget rebuilds every pay source's template at once. The tab bar also stays pinned to the top while you scroll.
New setup walkthrough: a guide that takes you from an empty budget to a working one, step by step. Open it any time from Help.
Deposits we noticed: the Income view now spots repeating paychecks and turns them into pay sources with one click.
You can add a new person right inside the pay source dialog.
Manage envelopes is now on the Budget tab, so you can set up envelopes before go-live.
Go-live now starts today by default, so balances show up right away.
New Disney color theme, and the theme picker in Settings is now a dropdown.
A divider now separates Spending, Bills, and Goals on the Envelopes screen.
Help now has What's new (this list) and Submit feedback.
Updates now come from the app: an Update available button appears at the top when there is a new version (Help > Check for updates). The launch shortcut no longer pulls from git.
Submit feedback now opens in your email app instead of replacing the EVBudget window.
You can now choose which folder bank files are read from: Import > Change folder. Each budget remembers its own.

Rules is now a full page under Import (Import | Rules | History), with the list and editor side by side. Every way of applying rules (one rule, or all of them) opens the same review screen: a tick box on each change, hand-edited rows marked and unticked, and nothing changes until you press Apply.
Selecting transactions now shows one Bulk update button with every option (payee, envelope, status, kind) in a single window.
Fixed: after a bulk update left a filter with no matching transactions, the charts could break and the page kept saying it could not connect until you restarted. It now refreshes normally.

What's new is clearer: after an update it lists every version since the one you were on, the update window previews the changes before you install, and Help > What's new shows each version separately.
